name: Dominaria's Judgment — protection from white and green with a Plains and a Forest, not the other three
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). "creatures you control gain protection from white if you control a Plains, from blue if you control an Island, …, and from green if you control a Forest." Only "protection from white" was read. Each "from X if Y" is now a sentence of its own with its own condition. With a Plains and a Forest the Bears have protection from white and from green only.
